The University of Birmingham India Outstanding Achievement Scholarships 2023, UK is an opportunity offered by the University of Birmingham* for Indian students applying for an undergraduate programme at the University of Birmingham. A total of four highest-performing students will be awarded GBP 2,500 towards tuition fees (for the first year only) for a full-time undergraduate degree programme at the University starting in September 2022.
*The University of Birmingham is a public research university located in Edgbaston, Birmingham, United Kingdom.
To be eligible, the applicants must -
have accepted an offer for a full-time undergraduate programme at the University of Birmingham for the session in September 2023
be classed by the University as an overseas fee payer for tuition fee purposes
be able to pay the outstanding tuition fees which is not covered under the scholarship
have sufficient funds to cover the full cost of living at the University of Birmingham, plus any visa/travel expenses associated with studying in the UK
The students who are already registered and studying a programme at the University of Birmingham in the UK are not eligible.
The students who are applying for MBChB Medicine and Surgery or BDS Dental Surgery programme are not eligible for this scholarship.
The applicants must be registered and their graduate study application must be attached to one of the local representatives of the university.
